Title: 3 'Healthy' Habits Secretly Causing Your Bloating (Protein Bars, Whey, Keto)

Description:
Bloated by mid-afternoon even though you barely ate? If you're deep into a high-protein routine, three parts of that routine might be why.

"High fiber" protein bars often get that fiber from chicory root, mostly inulin your gut can't break down - about 10 grams is enough to trigger gas. Whey shakes carry real milk lactose, and a big post-workout dose is a lot to process at once. And cutting carbs hard for keto drops your overall fiber fast, which slows digestion and causes its own kind of bloating.

Watch to find out the fixes - from swapping to whey isolate to keeping chia seeds and avocado in your rotation.
